status: repair frozen after v0.1 numerical nonidentifiability and before repaired endpoint readback
defect: The v0.1 full-sample simultaneous same/adjacent/distant dummy model became rank-deficient in informative pair x species groups where those categories exhausted all ten stops, producing non-finite standard errors and absurd coefficients. The biological contrast itself was prespecified and is unchanged.
unchanged_question: Is species-specific prior strong-chorus memory more localized to the exact physical SiteID than to immediately adjacent StopNumbers?
repaired_primary_design: Restrict to pair x species groups containing at least one same-site-memory stop AND at least one adjacent-site-only-memory stop. Within each such group, retain only those two stop classes. Regress demeaned wet_strong on demeaned same-site indicator, log1p(other-species prior strong richness), and prior site effort; no intercept; route-clustered covariance. The same-site coefficient is exactly the prespecified same-minus-adjacent contrast.
primary_prediction: Repaired same-minus-adjacent coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0.
secondary: Separately compare adjacent-site-only versus distant-route-site-only groups using the same pairwise contrast construction; descriptive only.
gate: At least 300 pair x species groups for the same-vs-adjacent primary contrast, >=200 routes and >=20 species.
prohibited: No use of v0.1 divergent full-sample coefficients.
No change to the biological endpoint or category definitions.
No interpretation of the repair as confirmatory beyond this post-readback exploration.
